build_script_inputs/extra_inputs/incremental_policy → Rust key/prediction decisions; declarations and mutation validation
wrapper/hit/compile → kache-store/compile preclean; output completeness, diagnostics, mtimes, carrier isolation
scheduler/demand/machine → wrapper compile/discovery flights; permit and per-key lock lifetimes
wrapper/remote → daemon/daemon_publish; failed handoff, cancellation, child ownership and spooled artifacts

daemon build sessions/manifests ↔ planner_client/build_intent/remote_plan; fallback and bounded prefetch
Config/socket paths/service environment ↔ daemon control/replacement; read-only credential lifetime and readiness
cli/login + config ↔ planner_auth/client/server auth; credential origin and trusted endpoint binding
target liveness/cleanup/seeding ↔ Cargo build dirs/incremental/out-dir aliases; active readers and persistent artifacts
events/report/timeline ↔ kache-core timeline and timeline_client/server ingest; schema, counters, bounded retention
Cargo metadata/build.rs/install assets/scripts/Helm/Nix ↔ service/config/shim behavior; installed artifacts and version contracts
kache-e2e/scripts/CI/scenario oracles ↔ each domain-specific test; real compiler/process/remote observations and meaningful failure discrimination
Rust wrapper discovery/eligibility/compilation ↔ cache key and native dependency closure; predicted and actual inputs, stable reuse, mutation guard
C/C++/CUDA classification/probes/depfiles ↔ cache key/path/native inputs; compiler-observable flags and identity
wrapper.run_cc/run_nvcc dispatch and generic adapter interface ↔ concrete compiler execution and restore
kache-fs clone/copy/identity and target lifetime/reclamation ↔ store publication/link/carrier leases and blob references
CLI flags/config and command dispatch ↔ events, reports, explain, statistics, schemas and terminal output
